Magic
Spell Slots: O0: 9; O1: 7; O2: 7; O3: 7; O4: 6; O5: 6; O6: 6; O7: 6; O8: 6; O9: 6 Spell DC: Gaseous Form: 13; Invisibility: 13; O: 13
Spells:
Alter Winds (O1 Tran): Increases or decreases severe winds 1 step in a 10' radius around touched for 20 hr
Cloak Of Winds (O3 Abju): R75' Foes of the target suffer -4 ranged attacks; Tiny foes cannot touch the target, are pushed away 100', and suffer 3d6 HP nonlethal, plus 1d6 HP if it strikes a solid object, (save Fortitude negates) for 20 min
Control Weather (O7 Tran): Modifies seasonal weather in a 2 mile radius for 4d12 hr
Control Winds (O5 Tran): R800' Changes the wind direction and speed by 6 levels in a 800'x40' cylinder for 200 min (save Fortitude each rd negates wind effects on a creature for 1 rd)
Gaseous Form (Gaseous Form3 Tran): Touched becomes insubstantial, losing its armor bonus to Armor Class, any supernatural abilities, ability to manipulate objects, and ability to cast spells with components, but gaining DR 10/magic, immunity to poison, Sneak Attack, and critical hits, a 10' fly Speed, and the ability to pass through small openings, for 40 min
Greater Invisibility (Invisibility4 Illu): Touched becomes invisible (save Will negates), gaining +20 Stealth when moving and +40 when still, for 20 rd
Gust Of Wind (O2 Evoc): Creates a 60' line of wind for 1 rd that moves objects, extinguishes unprotected flames, knocks down Small and smaller creatures, and halts Medium ones (save Fortitude negates; a successful DC 15 Strength check allows Medium creatures to move); Tiny creatures are also pushed 1d4x10', suffering 1d4 HP nonlethal per 10'; flying creatures suffer a -4 penalty on Fly checks and require a DC 20 Fly check to move against the wind, with Tiny flying creatures blown back 2d6x10', suffering 2d6 HP nonlethal (save Fly DC 25 negates)
Invisibility (Invisibility2 Illu): Touched becomes invisible (save Will negates), gaining +20 Stealth when moving and +40 when still, for 20 min; target attacking ends the spell
River Of Wind (O4 Evoc): 5'x120' line inflicts 4d6 HP nonlethal and knocked prone initially (Fortitude half HP only), then 2d6 HP nonlethal, pushed 20', and knocked prone (Fortitude 1d6 HP only) for 19 rd
Sirocco (O6 Evoc): R300' 60' high, 20' radius inflicts 4d6+20 HP fire, fatigued, and knocked prone (Fortitude half HP and fatigued only; water creatures suffer a -4 penalty on the save) and inflicts falling damage on flying creatures (save Fly DC 15 negates) for 20 rd
Whirlwind (O8 Evoc): R1200' Creates a 10' radius, 30' high cyclone that moves 60' as directed each rd, inflicting 3d6 HP on Large and smaller creatures (save Reflex negates), for 20 rd; it traps Medium and smaller creatures (save Reflex negates), inflicting an additional 1d8 HP on each subsequent rd
Winds Of Vengeance (O9 Evoc): Gives self a 60' fly Speed and immunity to wind, gas, and ranged weapons; inflicts on attackers 5d8 HP bludgeoning and knocked prone, or blown away if flying (save Fortitude half HP only; Huge flying creatures are checked instead), for 20 min
Magic Notes:
Charisma Oracle Spell Slot Bonus: Spell level O1, O2, O3
Spell Focus (Enchantment): +1 Spell DC (Enchantment)
Elemental Spell (Cold): May use +1 spell slot to convert half or all spell damage to cold damage
Empower Spell: Can cast a spell using a spell slot 2 levels higher than normal to increase its variable effects by 50%
Final Revelation (Wind Mystery): May apply Enlarge Spell, Extend Spell, Silent Spell, or Still Spell to air and electricity spells w/out cost
Gaseous Form: Can use Gaseous Form effects for 20 min per day; including others uses an equal portion of daily time for each
Invisibility: Can use Invisibility effects for 20 min per day or Greater Invisibility effects for 20 rd per day
Maximize Spell: Can cast a spell using a spell slot 3 levels higher than normal to maximize all of its variable effects
Orisons: Knows 0-level spells
Quicken Spell: Once per rd, can cast a spell with a casting time of up to 1 rd as a free action, using a spell slot 4 levels higher than normal
Reach Spell: May cast touch, close, or medium range spell at longer range; uses +1 spell slot/range increase
Silent Spell: Can cast a spell using a spell slot 1 level higher than normal to cast it without verbal components
Vortex Spells: Critical hits with spells stagger the target for 1d4 rd
